classData.comment:
/**
 * @summary Executes one Group's semantic write, with presentation outside its critical section.
 * @description The manager supplies serialization and participant ownership. This executor prepares
 * immutable endpoints before invoking synchronous, compensatable adopters. History and the current
 * snapshot join that same rollback boundary; observers run only after all semantic truth agrees.
 * @class Neo.manager.transaction.Commit
 * @extends Neo.core.Base
 */
classData.summary: Executes one Group's semantic write, with presentation outside its critical section.
classData.description: The manager supplies serialization and participant ownership. This executor prepares immutable endpoints before invoking synchronous, compensatable adopters. History and the current snapshot join that same rollback boundary; observers run only after all semantic truth agrees.
classData.name: Commit

classData.summary: Copies and freezes a finite JSON value before it reaches a semantic write.
classData.name: copy

classData.summary: Captures a participant's value and its opaque generation/revision stamps.
classData.name: capture

     * @param {Neo.manager.Transaction} manager
